_doc: MEDIA - YouTube channels for the Media tab, read by the PAGE (media-core.js / media-ui.js), not by the engine: the page fetches each channel's public Atom feed (`https://www.youtube.com/feeds/videos.xml?channel_id=<ID>` or `playlist_id=<ID>`, no key) through MediaBridge.fetchStart (native disk cache, https and a host allow-list), parses the yt:/media: namespaces and merges newest first. Before this the Media tab read a cache that only the engine's sync wrote, and the engine's sync never fetched media, so the feed stayed empty. Adding a channel is an entry here plus a rebuild. A channel may give channel_id (UC...), playlist_id (PL.../UU...) or only a handle (`@name`): a handle is resolved once from the channel page and remembered. Two ids found elsewhere in this repo (UCcflMGx-VSrcqQMGKmKzKHA, UCqWbKxpXU3wKlnpQnwvX8Kw) 404 and are deliberately excluded.
_doc_fields: id: stable slug. label: chip and card channel name. channel_id | playlist_id | handle: where the videos come from. category: groups channels into one chip each. avatar: optional https image of the channel (a letter disc is drawn without it). feed.cache_hours: how long a fetched feed is reused; feed.min_refresh_minutes: a pull-to-refresh cannot go under it; feed.page_size: cards added per infinite-scroll step. feed.auto_refresh: an automatic refresh on open (a stale cache) runs only when the network is unmetered (require_unmetered_network) and, if set, charging (require_charging), the same gate as the News updater (build.json::release auto-update); a pull-to-refresh and an EMPTY cache always fetch. No timers, no background job. chips: the order of the chip groups at the top of the feed (all, shorts, live, category, channel); shorts and live appear only when a video of that kind is known.
